How it works

From artwork to bottle in three steps

1

Pick your panels

Choose any of the seven ad panels: the upper and lower panels on the front, right and left, and the upper back. Or take a whole side.

2

Upload artwork

Add a JPG, PNG or WEBP for each panel and rotate the bottle to check it. Our size guide tells you the exact dimensions.

3

Send it to AquaAd

Add your details and send. We receive your artwork and a four-sided mockup, review your design and get back to you.

The lower back panel is reserved for AquaAd company information.

Design studio

3D bottle preview

Tick the panels you want, then upload artwork to each one. 7 of the 8 panels are for sale. The lower back holds AquaAd company information.
